records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales of Grand Theft Auto products generated 18.3% of our net revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2022, Net Bookings increased by $291.1 as compared to the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We had three customers who accounted for 26.7%, 13.5%, and 10.8%, of our gross accounts receivable as of June 30, 2022, and two customers who accounted for 43.5% and 20.3% of our gross accounts receivable as of March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Further, as a result of the platform fees associated with online game sales, our Mobile Net revenue generally generates lower gross margin percentage than our Console or PC revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We did not have any additional customers that exceeded 10% of our gross accounts receivable as of June 30, 2022, and March 31, 2022.
